body_markdown:
“We put our baby down for bed around 7pm. She was sound asleep, but around 2am, our[Owlet Dream Sock](https://owletcare.com/products/owlet-dream-sock?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=blog_post&utm_campaign=OwletStory) alerted us that her pulse rate was high, reading 220 BPM and then went up to 240 BPM.


We immediately called 911, and by the time she got to the hospital, her pulse rate was up to 280 BPM. She was admitted to the PICU. The doctors diagnosed her with supraventricular tachycardia (SVT) and we are now treating it with medicine in the short term.


I can’t tell you how grateful we are for this device! Because of our Dream Sock, we were able to see how high her pulse rate was and get her the medical attention she needed. Forever grateful!!!”


- Ali S.


Share your Owlet story[here](https://owletcare.com/pages/share-your-story?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=blogpost&utm_campaign=OwletStory) .


**As a reminder, Dream Sock® is intended to track your baby’s pulse rate and oxygen level and keep parents informed, but it is not intended to diagnose, treat or cure any disease or other condition including, but not limited to, Sudden Infant Death Syndrome (SIDS) and/or Respiratory Syncytial Virus (RSV). This story reflects one family’s experience. Individual experiences may vary.*
